account: Today there seems to be a quietly coordinated gathering in the town hall great hall at six. The innkeeper calls it a community meal, has said everything is ready and I need bring nothing, and specifically asked me not to arrive early. My neighbour heard the innkeeper coordinating with Freight and the builder. I also overheard my neighbour say they had kept an earlier conversation private as requested, ask to join the gathering, and later offer to welcome someone when he arrives. Taken together, I suspect a friendly surprise, possibly for me, rather than ordinary inn business, though I do not yet know its purpose. The secretary has been handling the appointment and assures me there are no new council letters or urgent matters. My neighbour says nothing witnessed firsthand gives cause for alarm. There have also been vague remarks about a bridge or port change, but I have no confirmation of any such development. Freight explicitly requested no town assistance with warehouse coordination; the builder mentioned funding shortages, without arranging a private appointment. I should not assume those matters explain the meal. Tomorrow's ten o'clock mill inspection remains provisional because the secretary has not found the miller to confirm it. For now I am waiting in my office until the agreed time, rather than intruding on preparations.
